description: Testbenches shipped for T1 item 9. The cocotb stream bench (test_fft256_stream.py) drives the streaming wrapper over the generated core and checks it bit-exactly against the bit-accurate model, plus handshake (including the in_ready and out_valid equations against the core valid), back-pressure, reset mid-frame and zero model overflow, with a negative control (fft-bench-negctl). The remaining listed benches are the existing item 9 evidence: the model and reference tests and the generated-core smoke; the Icarus wrapper smoke bench was removed in favour of the cocotb stream bench. cold_start runs every bench and negative control from a venv built from verification/requirements.txt (see verification/README.md); it is local_only because it needs Icarus, so the signoff.yml runner skips it under --check and re-verifies the recorded hashes. Supersedes manifests/item9-inventory.json and its attestation manifests/item9-attestation.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which cite the removed verification/tb_fft256_stream.sv and the sim-wrapper targets.
